inv.desc_en: Spectacular premises ready to move into, consisting of a large room, two bathrooms, two storage rooms, and a very spacious utility room. This magnificent street-level property has a wonderful open terrace of over thirty meters. It is located next to the Turia River and has a lot of foot traffic. A wonderful opportunity, don't let it slip away and come see it; we have flexible visiting hours. The premises also feature two glass display windows and excellent visibility for pedestrians, as well as people passing by on bikes or in cars. A unique opportunity. -.. . Call us, our commercial advisors will assist you during extended business hours. If you send us an email, please include your phone number so we can contact you as soon as possible.
